title: Common problems
summary: Quick fixes for the usual hosting troubles.

sections.heading: The server crashes or stops on start
steps: Open the Logs page. The tool writes what happened and what to do.
If it says the server cannot load a DLL, click the red Unblock DLLs button, then start again.
A save from an older TAOM does not load. Start a new 2.0.29.5 campaign in single player.
With extra mods, try Plain TAOM. If that works, use Test mods on the server to find the mod.

sections.heading: Mods do not match
steps: When a player's mods differ, the Logs page says which mods are missing or do not match.
Click Share mod list and have the player use Import mod list in the client launcher.
The player picks the same setup, with the same mods in the same order.

sections.heading: Stuck on loading
steps: The first start of a new campaign builds the map cache. It can take up to an hour.
The gold bar shows how far it is. Do not stop the server, or it starts over.
Friends wait until the status says Server online before they connect.

sections.heading: Shader cache
steps: The server tool has no shader cache. Shaders belong to each player's game.
After the mod list changes, a player's game can build its shaders again once, so that start is slower.
If graphics look wrong for a player, they click Clear shader cache on the Settings page of the client launcher.

sections.heading: Get help
steps: Click Send my logs on the left. The password and addresses are taken out, and saves are left out. You get a short code like CR-7KQ2M.
Post only that code in Discord, not the log files.
Open server logs opens the logs folder.
